preconditions.description: The input string is non-empty and has length not greater than 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only lowercase letters, digits, and dots.

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) <= 10 for name in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(0, len(stdin), 1), range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each name in the bill has length not more than 10.

preconditions.expression: all(price[0].isdigit() and price[-1].isdigit() for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price starts and ends with a digit.

preconditions.expression: all('.' not in price[:-1] or price.count('.') == 1 for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price has at most one dot (decimal point) except possibly at the end.

preconditions.expression: all(len(price.split('.')) == 1 or (len(price.split('.')) == 2 and len(price.split('.')[1]) == 2) for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price is either an integer or has exactly two digits after the decimal point.

preconditions.expression: all(any(c.isdigit() for c in price.split('.')[0]) for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price has at least one digit before any decimal point.

preconditions.expression: all(len(price.split('.')) == 1 or (len(price.split('.')) == 2 and price.split('.')[1].isdigit()) for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price has digits only in the cents part if a decimal point is present.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < float(price.replace('.', '')) / 100 <= 10**6 for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j])
preconditions.description: Each price is not less than one cent and not greater than 10^6 dollars.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == format_total_price(sum(float(price.replace('.', '')) / 100 for price in [stdin[i:j] for i, j in zip(range(11, len(stdin) + 1, 11), range(11 + 1, len(stdin) + 1, 11)) if i < j]))
postconditions.description: The output is the total price of all purchases in the bill, formatted exactly as per the input price format.
